subject: Napoli coach Allegri sent off in 3-3 draw with Roma and banned for two matches
title: Allegri's ban and the cutout ref

lines.vo: Red card, late equaliser, and Allegri joking about his own ban.
Napoli drew three-three with Roma. Allegri says the late goal was a foul. The goal stood. His argument did not.
Two matches out, a ten-thousand-euro fine, and Napoli first said they would appeal.
Then Allegri dropped the appeal and joked the ban could grow to four. Very relaxed man.
lines.footage: Allegri sent off reaction press conference

lines.vo: He misses Monza, then Juventus, his old club. Five Serie A titles there. Napoli are struggling. Bad timing.

facts_used: ev0003: Allegri was shown a straight red card after Roma's late equaliser by Balerdi in the 3-3 draw; he argued the goal should have been disallowed for a foul on Beukema (news/news_dedup.json)
ev0003: Lega Serie A banned him for two matches (Monza and Juventus, both away) and fined him 10,000 euros (news/news_dedup.json)
ev0003: Napoli first said they would appeal; Allegri decided not to and joked the ban could grow to four (news/news_dedup.json)

notes: Comic (southpark_cutout). The ban was for insulting officials and aggressive behaviour, per Lega Serie A. Those reasons and Allegri's denial stay out of the jokes; the voice line uses only the ban and red card. The '4' insert and the VAR sticker gag are fictional gags on the documented joke about four matches. Insert after_line is 0-based. Punch-up pass: merged the 'five Serie A titles' line into the Juventus joke (old club, both ban matches away). Reasons for the ban stay out of all jokes.
